title: Industrial Designer
note: Grill and outdoor-cooking product design at Char-Broil's parent company; asks for 1–3 years of experience.

facts.summary: Industrial designer on W.C. Bradley product development teams, reporting to the Senior Director of ID.
facts.duties: Develop concepts and product drawings, build 3D models for review, make control drawings, approve color/aesthetics on first pieces.
facts.requirements: Bachelor's in industrial design, 1–3 years related experience, CAD (Ashlar Vellum or similar), drawing and model-making; Adobe and Mac a plus.
facts.apply: Apply on the W.C. Bradley careers site.
